title: Worst flood in over 20 years, says village head | The Star
text: Worst flood in over 20 years, says village head | The Star × View Community Worst flood in over 20 years, says village head By ELAN PERUMAL Wednesday, 21 Sep 2016 | 12:00 AM MYT share bookmark Related Stories Singapore 26 Sep 2026 Air quality in Singapore's central region back in unhealthy range; 24-hour PSI reading at 108 Singapore 1d ago Haze in Singapore: Air quality in all five regions unhealthy, PM2.5 readings elevated across island Singapore 19 Sep 2026 Haze in Singapore: PSI in central region back in the unhealthy range Temporary shelter: A woman with a baby are among evacuees at the Kampung Tok Muda community hall in Kapar. About 150 people from 34 families in Kampung Tok Muda in Kapar, Klang are putting up at a community hall in the village following two days of flash floods in the area.
